title: When selecting a small menu first and then a big one, the big one is incomplete
line: In the Global Menu, moving from a short menu to a long one now shows the whole long menu, scrollable when it doesn't fit.
explanation: The Global Menu shows every app menu in one popup. When the pointer (or Left/Right) moved to another menu while one was open, the applet swapped the actions and only moved the popup, so it kept a size computed by adjustSize(), which caps windows at 2/3 of the screen, and never set up scrolling. A long menu opened after a short one was therefore cut off with no scroll arrows, while opening it directly with a click was fine. The popup is now shown again with popup() also when it is already open, so Qt fits it to the new menu (repositioning the same Wayland popup) exactly like a direct click.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: Resize the menu when switching to another one

When the pointer moved to another menu while one was open, the popup was
only moved, so a long menu opened after a short one was cut off and could
not scroll. Show it again with popup(), which fits it to the new menu.

BUG: 523027

media.caption: Dolphin: Help opened, then pointer moved to View: View is cut off (Show Panels and Location Bar missing)
Same steps with the fix: View is complete
Test app with a 70-item menu: Small opened, then pointer moved to Big: Big ends at item 17, no scroll arrow
Same steps with the fix: Big fills the screen with a scroll arrow, like a direct click
